answer: For agents selling shale surveys, river ripple forecasts, or plume tracking, require each earning identity to lock a bond for thirty days. Randomly assigned auditors check signed task receipts against hidden test cases; proven fabricated receipts burn the bond, with an appeal before independent auditors. A farmer running a thousand identities must immobilize a thousand bonds and pay for each audit. Cap rewards per bond so splitting identities cannot increase returns on the same capital.
